title: Media source _id is the bare content hash, so two tenants ingesting identical media collide on sources._id when a real sink inserts
evidence: hosted-recording.ts and youtube.ts set source._id = hash and media _id = hash-media with no tenant component. The intake planner looks up sessions by (tenantId, sourceId), so tenant B sees no existing session and calls save; a store with a global _id unique index would reject the insert (test: same media in tenant-a and tenant-b is planned as created for both; the in-memory sink has no unique index).
fix_direction: Out of this unit (changes adapter id scheme, affects D-135 dedupe key and existing data): prefix _id with tenantId or add a compound unique key. Needs owner choice; wiring unit must handle it.
